capture.coverage: Native linear project JSONL user/assistant text, native item IDs and integer millisecond clocks, project/root-namespaced session identities, recorded cwd. CODEBUDDY_CONFIG_DIR overrides the config root; global input history and active-session metadata are excluded.

Native function call/result callId joins, full inline toolResult.content including spills, raw markers and per-upstream-message rawUsage counters counted once. Embedded output paths are never read. Sidecar-only outputs, unrecognized control facts fail closed; no delegation or resume execution inferred.

Published native recorder and fresh high-level historical restore/replay oracle prove branch tombstone, pending rewind and compaction ancestry; retained pre-compaction messages stay searchable, controls and summaries remain markers. Native reasoning nodes stay opaque; adjacent native message fragments are preserved. Native title facts use custom/AI/topic precedence. Runtime-only lane moves without durable facts cannot be inferred.
